<thought>I will search the template catalog for a forward reaction that forms a C=C double bond while breaking a ketone and a trimethylsilyl group, which corresponds to the Peterson olefination. This will give me a template ID that I can use in the retrosynthetic route.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "C=C(C1=CC=C(OC)C=C1)C2=CC=C(OC)C=C2",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["ketone", "trimethylsilyl"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["C=C"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
